 Welcome to Famous Original Ray’s Pizza - Proudly Serving New Yorkers 

 
 
 
 
 Serving New Yorkers authentic Italian pizza and classic dishes for over 50 years! Visit our Midtown West, Upper West Side, or Times Square locations for a truly iconic NYC dining experience. 

 Learn More About Us 
 
 
 
 
 Fresh, Flavorful, and Authentic 

 
 
 
 
 Order delicious Italian cuisine from Famous Original Rays Pizza online for convenient delivery or takeout. We’re located in Midtown West, just steps away from iconic spots like Times Square and Bryant Park. 

 Order Now 
 
 
 
 
 


 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 Pizza Delivered to Your Door
 
 
 Craving pizza? Order online for fast delivery or convenient carry-out from any of our three Manhattan locations. Your favorite slices are just a click away!
 
 Order Now 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Customer Reviews
 
 
 Check out our most recent reviews!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Thomas Strehle 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Back at Rays after many years and did not disappoint. Best slice ever one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had. Crust is perfectly crusty and ingredients deliciously fresh. Nice roomy location and friendly service! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Eliana Moreno 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Nice place, big dinning area perfect for groups and families, great crunch pizza, delicious pastas and hero sandwiches! Very friendly staff! I recommend ❤️❤️ 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Izabelle D. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Ray’s Pizza is a fantastic spot and one of our go-to places. The staff is always incredibly friendly, sweet, and welcoming, which makes every visit feel special. We go often and genuinely love the food, especially the options from the food bar.

Everything is consistently fresh and delicious, and the chicken wings are 
 ... 
 especially great. The atmosphere is warm, the service is delightful, and it’s just an all-around enjoyable place to visit. We always leave happy and looking forward to coming back. 
 Read More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Norvito /mom 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Great place for a slice. Came in right as a fresh pie was coming out of the oven, had to have 2 slices….Good service as well. Employees are always friendly. Place is kept clean. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Heenal A 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 There was a wide selection of vegetation and meat pizzas. The pizza was delicious and the vibe of the restaurant was great. Plenty of seating friendly atmosphere. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 H. Ed Reed 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Loaded up supreme slice at a reasonable price. Finding a slice of pizza in NY is pretty easy. Finding a good slice of pizza gets a little more tricky. Ray’s is worth the trip uptown to get a slice. The hand-tossed crust was done to perfection and the toppings were generous. And all for a price that won’t break the 
 ... 
 bank. 
 Read More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Gina Orozco 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Only my 2nd ever NYC slice but it was delicious. And a lot better than the first one. Would definitely go back to try more. Thanks Ray! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Jessica Shovan 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely fantastic pizza! The crust was perfectly crisp on the outside and soft on the inside, the sauce was rich and flavorful, and the toppings were super fresh. You can tell they put real care into every pie. The staff was friendly, welcoming, and quick to serve, and the whole place had a warm, 
 ... 
 inviting atmosphere. 
 Read More 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Ethan Jackson 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Came here with my family, my dad used to live in NY. He told us he knows exactly where to get pizza, because he used to eat here all the time. The second our plane landed, we came to rays. The pizza is amazing, and it is the best thing I ate in New York. Now our trips over and we are eating here one last time. Highly 
 ... 
 recommend
